name: Moodle Integration
description: Optional Moodle LMS integration for cached course discovery, enrollment handoff, SSO launch, and tenant-safe sync.
author: GitHub Copilot

settings_fields.label: Moodle Base URL
settings_fields.help: Base URL of the external Moodle instance. Leave blank to keep the integration inactive.

settings_fields.label: Moodle API Token
settings_fields.help: Web Services token used for Moodle REST API calls.

settings_fields.label: SSO Shared Secret
settings_fields.help: Shared secret used to sign Moodle launch payloads.

settings_fields.label: Tenant Mode
settings_fields.help: Choose whether each tenant targets its own Moodle base URL or shares a common Moodle instance.

settings_fields.label: Enrollment Mode
settings_fields.help: Controls whether learner enrollment requests require review, can auto-enroll immediately, or wait for an external payment confirmation before enrollment.

settings_fields.label: Sync Interval
settings_fields.help: Used by the scheduled sync jobs and the diagnostics UI.

settings_fields.label: Shared Category Mapping
settings_fields.help: Optional JSON map of tenant identifiers to Moodle category IDs when tenant mode is shared. Shared-mode course access is denied unless the resolved Moodle category matches the tenant mapping.

settings_fields.label: Max Outbound Requests Per Minute
settings_fields.help: Maximum number of Moodle API calls allowed per minute per tenant. Protects the upstream Moodle instance from request spikes. Set to 0 to disable limiting.

settings_fields.label: Burst Limit Per Sync Job
settings_fields.help: Maximum number of Moodle API calls a single sync job execution is allowed to make. Prevents one job from consuming the entire per-minute budget.

settings_fields.label: Staleness Threshold (minutes)
settings_fields.help: Progress data older than this many minutes is considered stale. When a learner opens their dashboard or a course page, a targeted reconciliation sync is dispatched automatically for any stale rows. Set to 0 to disable on-demand reconciliation.
